description: Defines a generic Result class for handling HTTP responses, including status, payload, cache directives, and response creation logic within the org.eclipse.hono.service.management package.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A generic class representing an HTTP response with status, payload, and optional cache directives, capable of creating event bus responses.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the optional cache directive associated with the response.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload of the response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates an error, using HttpUtils.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Result instance with a given status and supplier for custom response types.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage response based on the request, status, and payload mapper.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Prepares a string representation helper including status, cacheDirective, and payload.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Result instance.
